description: This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of the Trino Coordinator status, performance, and resource usage. Metrics are scraped by Prometheus via the jmx-exporter for Trino Coordinator deployments.

panels.title: Cluster Status Overview
Number of active workers
Number of blocked workers
Total number of CPU cores

panels.description: Represents the total amount of memory (in bytes) allocated across the entire cluster for distributed queries. This includes the memory used by all worker nodes participating in query execution.
panels.title: Total Distributed Bytes (cluster memory pool)

panels.description: The total amount of free memory (in bytes) available in the distributed memory pool across the Trino cluster.
panels.title: Free Distributed Bytes (cluster memory pool)

panels.description: The total amount of memory (in bytes) allocated in the cluster-wide memory pool for "revocable" distributed queries.
panels.title: Reserved Revocable Distributed Bytes (cluster memory pool)

panels.description: Memory reserved for distributed queries that is not revocable (i.e., cannot be taken back).
panels.title: Reserved Distributed Bytes (cluster memory pool)

panels.description: The total amount of memory (in bytes) reserved by user queries across the entire Trino cluster.
panels.title: Cluster User Memory Reservation (Total memory used by Running queries)

panels.description: The total amount of memory (in bytes) reserved across the entire Trino cluster, including memory used by user queries and system processes.
panels.title: Cluster Total Memory Reservation (Total memory used by running queries)
Query Execution Overview

panels.description: The total number of queries currently running in the Trino cluster.
panels.title: Number of Running Queries

panels.description: This metric represents the total number of queries currently queued and waiting to start execution in the Trino cluster.
panels.title: Number of Queued Queries

panels.description: This metric represents the total number of queries that have been submitted to the Trino cluster since it started.
panels.title: Number of queries submitted per minute
Number of queries completed per minute
Number of failed queries per minute

panels.description: This metric represents the number of queries that have leaked memory in Trino. A leaked query is one where memory was allocated but not properly released after query execution finished (successfully or unsuccessfully).
panels.title: Total number of queries with memory leaks per minute

panels.description: The total number of OOM killed queries per minute
panels.title: The total number of OOM killed queries per minute

Overview of recently completed Query data processing

panels.description: This metric represents the total count of bytes consumed as input across all queries in Trino. It tracks how much data has been ingested by Trino during query execution.
panels.title: The cumulative value of the number of bytes processed by the query in the past minute

panels.description: This metric represents the total count of CPU time consumed by queries in seconds across all executions in Trino. It tracks the amount of CPU time used during the execution of queries, helping to understand the computational workload on the system.
panels.title: The cumulative time consumed to complete the QueryCPU in the past minute

panels.description: This metric represents the average rate of input bytes consumed by queries over the last minute. It tracks the rate of data ingestion (in bytes per second) for queries in Trino over a 1-minute period.
panels.title: Average rate of query data processing completed in the past minute

panels.description: This metric represents the maximum rate of input bytes consumed by queries during any 1-minute period. It tracks the peak data ingestion rate for queries in Trino, showing the highest throughput of data being ingested per second during the last minute.
panels.title: The maximum rate of query data processing completed in nearly one minute

panels.description: This metric represents the average execution time of queries over a 1-minute interval. It measures how long, on average, queries are taking to execute during that time period in Trino.
panels.title: The average query execution time in one minute.

panels.description: This metric represents the maximum execution time of any query over a 1-minute interval. It shows the longest execution time for any query that ran during the last minute in Trino.
panels.title: The maximum query execution time in one minute.
